GraceUXGuidelines.Audience: People working across related pages, tools, notes, files, agent runs, and long-lived workspaces.
GraceUXGuidelines.Guideline: The environment should feel aware of the current activity rather than present an empty browser or a detached chatbot.
Agent actions remain visible, inspectable, interruptible, and confirmation-gated before consequential external side effects.
History is presented as activity, decisions, results, and open questions rather than only URLs and timestamps.
